business_summary.headline: Another clean day across the board. All 23 core routes and 10 freshly-sampled destinations served correctly in both English and Hindi, the API layer returned zero server errors, the emergency-SOS safety floor is exactly at baseline across all 533 destinations, the maps render correctly on both page templates, and the React hydration warning stayed silent across all 5 checks. One small, genuinely new observation while testing today: the decorative map coordinate bug (showing the same fixed point on India's map regardless of destination) showed up on three more pages, continuing a small, cosmetic, well-understood issue.
